renderer: render_fig4.py (hand-written matplotlib on the aii-data-fig-gen house style; the catalogue 'line' type has no asymmetric CI band or reference line)
chart: line: consensus AUROC against number of peer families k, overall with 95% CI band and long-sentence tercile, full-pool reference line

source.population: development set E, R_AB rows (tiers A+B, CORRECT vs ERROR, LLM candidates) with all 7 other vendor families available: n = 2014 candidates (1309 ERROR / 705 CORRECT), 186 sentences
source.aggregation: AUROC averaged over 50 reproducible random k-subsets of the candidate's 7 other families; CI = 95% sentence-cluster bootstrap (B = 2000) of that mean
source.tercile: T3 = longest third of sentences by word count (pre-registered cuts, prereg_mech.json)
source.not_plotted: k = 8, 9 exist only in a slot-level sensitivity run on 856 rows / 73 sentences, a different population, so the primary curve stops at k = 7. The 0.785 of the cross-fitted best fixed 3-family pool is a different quantity (one chosen pool, not a random-subset mean) and is not drawn.
